QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_12

question.text: Indus Valley AIF amended its PPM mid-year to clarify valuation methodology (non-material). The consolidated intimation of ALL PPM changes in a financial year must be sent to SEBI and investors within:

answer.text: 1 month of the end of the financial year, on a consolidated basis
6 months of year-end, along with the audited accounts

explanation.text: **The Logic:** SEBI's reporting circular requires AIFs to intimate all PPM and fund-document changes on a CONSOLIDATED basis within 1 MONTH of the end of each financial year, clearly citing changed clauses with revised page references. Material changes may separately trigger exit rights per 15.4.2. **The Trap:** 15 / 30 days per change confuses with real-time disclosure triggers for material events. 6-months waits for audited accounts — far too long. **Cross-Exam Context:** III-A/C and XIX-A/B test the 1-month consolidated timeline. XIX-C expects the Manager to distinguish between event-based material disclosures and the year-end consolidation. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Maintain a running PPM change log throughout the year with tracked-changes PDFs. On 1-Apr, the consolidation filing is a push-button exercise instead of a two-week scramble.
